content: The Khavāṣṣ-i ʿIlm-i Ṣarf treats questions of morphology in a lettrist manner, defining morphology (language itself) as the process by which singularity becomes multiplicity, all proceeding from the maṣdar; the pronoun huwa is implicit in all forms and is the source of the divine names; it was published by Bihbahānī and Dībājī in 1351 Sh./1972. The entry gives no date of composition.
